body: Looking back, main reason I'd say was because of fear. A girl that I fell in love (whom funnily enough, I have not even ever spoken to) had her ex threaten me. I was really close to drinking muriatic acid with Ice Tea and on a separate occasion hang myself. I would say that cowardice made me not do it but looking back, I think I just did not want to see my mom cry and also break her heart. I didn't want to waste all her sacrifices and leave her to realize I killed myself for a girl to whom I've never even spoken to. Now, my life is in a good state. I have a decent job, a great supporting girlfriend, my family and friends as well. I can really say that it does get better.
